info.name: University Research Opportunity Portal API
info.description:
API Test Suite for University Research Opportunity Portal (Computer Networks Assignment 01).
Covers all required test cases:
1. Creating at least 3 research opportunities
2. Retrieving all research opportunities
3. Retrieving one opportunity using its ID
4. Updating an existing opportunity
5. Changing an opportunity's status from Open to Closed
6. Deleting an opportunity
7. Requesting deleted opportunity to demonstrate 404 Not Found
8. Sending invalid/missing data to demonstrate 400 Bad Request input validation.
